name: Rina Hartono
headline: Operations Manager | I help 20-50 person B2B services firms cut invoice handling from 6 hours a week to under 2, without adding headcount
about:
I have spent nine years in operations roles inside services firms, most of them watching the same problem arrive twice: the process worked until the person who built it took leave.

That is the work I do now. I document what a team actually does before changing anything, so the result is something they own rather than something they depend on me to maintain.

Last year a 14-person finance team was spending six hours a week reconciling invoices by hand across three systems with no shared identifiers. We got it to forty minutes. Same headcount.

Eleven engagements since 2019, each starting the same way: watch someone do their own job, write down what actually happens rather than what the documentation claims.
